checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
The includesText names arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
No second mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead appears in the labels or disclosures.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the embalming price is on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket funeral without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation price range is on page 2, so same-page placement counts as correct.
Direct cremation is offered, but no text states a casket is required for direct cremation.
Direct cremation includes cremation and no separate crematory cash-advance charge is listed to create ambiguity.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all have itemized prices, and no package or description mentions another offered item without its own price.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not packages.
No text beyond the required disclosure wording asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase.
No claim about delaying decomposition or protecting the body from gravesite substances appears.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and no disclosure is shown printed in a way that is hard to notice.
